Kiran and Pallavi Patel Global University Grievance Redressal COMMITTEE OVERVIEW About the committee A grievance encompasses any manifestation of discontent, dissatisfaction, or negative perception, whether articulated or not, stemming from any aspect associated with the University, which a student perceives, or even senses, as being unjust, inequitable, or unfair. The Grievance Redressal System is a vital part of any administration. It falls under the purview of University Administration to ensure the provision of a secure and conducive environment for the students. In accordance with UGC guidelines, the Grievance Redressal Committee has been established within the university to address grievances raised by the students. This platform facilitates an open forum for students to express their concerns, and it is crucial for the complainant to exercise diligence and discretion in determining what constitutes a grievance significant enough to warrant the attention of the committee, which consists of senior administrators and faculty members of the university. PURPOSE Objectives of the Committee Objective 01 To provide a platform for students to address their grievances related to academic, administrative, or personal matters within the university. Objective 02 To ensure that grievances are addressed impartially and in a fair manner, without any bias or discrimination. Objective 03 To maintain confidentiality and privacy throughout the grievance resolution process, safeguarding the interests of all parties involved. Objective 04 To promote transparency in the handling of grievances by keeping all stakeholders informed about the progress and outcomes of the resolution process. Objective 05 To identify root causes of grievances and recommend measures to prevent their recurrence in the future, thereby fostering a positive and conducive environment within the university. Objective 06 To educate students about the grievance redressal mechanism and their rights and responsibilities in lodging and resolving grievances. Objective 07 To regularly review and improve the grievance redressal process based on feedback and emerging needs, ensuring its effectiveness and efficiency. Objective 08 To facilitate amicable resolution of grievances through mediation, negotiation, or other appropriate means, aiming for mutual understanding and agreement. COVERAGE Types of Grievance and Specification ✓ Academic administration and support services Admissions, examinations, assessments, evaluation, library facilities, issuance of certificates, add-on courses, research related issues, etc. ✓ Enrichment & Co-curricular activities Students’ club registration, award of non-academic credits, physical education, extra-curricular awards and certificates related issues etc. ✓ Facilities Management Allocation of class rooms, standard of canteen food, Wi-Fi internet connectivity, utility-stores, computer facilities, drinking water, sanitation & hygiene, maintenance, medical facilities related issues, etc. ✓ Professional Development On-campus or off-campus interviews, soft skills training, internships related issues, etc. ✓ Administrative affairs Collection of fee, online fee payment gateway, ID cards, attendance, scholarships, transcript, transportation, Bonafede certificates related issues, etc. ✓ Student Welfare and Campus Safety Safety & security, discipline, misbehaviours, emergency services, harassment by fellow students, teachers or staff related issues, etc. GOVERNANCE STRUCTURE Composition of KPGU Grievance Redressal Committee Chairperson Prof. (Dr.) Lalit Thakur A Dean/Director of the Faculty of the University on rotation nominated by Hon.Provost (I/C) Call 7861805171 Member Dr. Chirag Nagda Registrar of the University Call 7861805153 Member Prof. (Dr.) R. SUBMISSION PROCESS Procedure for Submitting Step-by-step approach Any stakeholder with a genuine grievance should initially approach the Department Student Grievance Redressal Committee (DSGRC) or the Institutional Student Grievance Redressal Committee (ISGRC). In the event that grievances still remain unresolved, students are encouraged to approach the University Grievance Redressal Committee (USGRC) to formally submit their grievances. REQUIRED DETAILS FOR SUBMISSION Include: full name, enrolment number, course name, branch or department, school name, mobile number, email address, type of grievance. Send an Email Submit your grievance digitally via the official grievance email address. student.grievance@kpgu.ac.in Written Application A formal handwritten or printed application can also be submitted directly to the committee members.
